scope: Corollary 4.5 of the manuscript “Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties” (preprints/Milnes-rationality-conjecture-for-abelian-varieties-October-7-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 001 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 640701a0ea8d8026), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The filtration of Theorem 4.1, with its finite local field descent, is admissible: the descended filtered isocrystal is the filtered crystalline module of a crystalline representation.
